The March 15 WFI annulus reference is the existing September 5 independent extraction from the Carruthers diagnostics folder. It records the 4.5–5.5 Earth-radius mean brightness and valid-pixel count for all 22 frames, and is preserved here so the same regression check runs on the Spark. It was not regenerated by the application under test.

`dst-kyoto-provisional-202603.txt` is the unmodified March 2026 provisional Dst
monthly file retrieved September 18, 2026 from WDC for Geomagnetism, Kyoto:
https://wdc.kugi.kyoto-u.ac.jp/dst_provisional/202603/dst2603.for.request
The independently published hourly table is at
https://wdc.kugi.kyoto-u.ac.jp/dst_provisional/202603/index.html and the fixed-width
record specification is at https://wdc.kugi.kyoto-u.ac.jp/dstae/format/dstformat.html.
The tests check all 744 hourly records, UTC hour centers, negative values and
missing-data handling. WDC Kyoto supplies these provisional data for non-commercial use.
